## Official Software Product Catalog

### 1. OptimaFix Pro (Windows Diagnostic & PC Repair Suite)
- **Primary Use Case**: High-speed Windows OS diagnostic, SMART drive health check, registry optimizer, DNS latency reset, and WinPE offline boot rescue.
- **Licensing Formats**:
  - **Digital Home License**: Base Price ₹999.00 (+ 18% GST ₹179.82 = ₹1,178.82 Total). 1 PC Lifetime Activation.
  - **Tech Pro Subscription**: Monthly Base ₹399.00/mo (+ 18% GST = ₹470.82/mo) or Annual Base ₹3,999.00/yr (+ 18% GST = ₹4,718.82/yr). Autopay Recurring. Unlimited PCs.
  - **Technician Rescue Boot**: Digital ISO Soft Copy Base ₹3,999.00 (+ 18% GST = ₹4,718.82) or Physical 16GB USB Hardware Drive Base ₹5,999.00 (+ 18% GST = ₹7,078.82).

### 2. OptiSpace PC Pro (OptiSpec PC Suite)
- **Primary Use Case**: Windows desktop disk analyzer and high-performance storage manager. Scans system volumes, visualizes space consumption, and purges orphaned files locally.
- **Pricing**: Base Price ₹499.00 (+ 18% GST ₹89.82 = ₹588.82 Total).

### 3. De-Vibe OMS Enterprise
- **Primary Use Case**: Enterprise Order Management System for omni-channel inventory synchronization, status routing, and ERP integration.
- **Pricing**: Base Price ₹14,999.00 (+ 18% GST ₹2,699.82 = ₹17,698.82 Total).

### 4. Bahamut OMS High-Frequency Engine
- **Primary Use Case**: Specialized high-frequency distributed database engine for extreme transaction volumes and sub-millisecond data synchronization.
- **Pricing**: Base Price ₹29,999.00 (+ 18% GST ₹5,399.82 = ₹35,398.82 Total).
